name: Mayaku
source:
Hero is a high school chemistry teacher. Accidentally he produces a powerful aphrodisiac. He indents to test the new medicine on different female students.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-june-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
